```
[LEARN]
insight: When fixing lint errors in batches, always run linter again after initial fixes to catch newly introduced issues
context: Any batch lint cleanup where changes might introduce new unused imports
```

```
[LEARN]
insight: Removing unused imports is a common "cleanup" that can cascade - removing one import may make another unused
context: Code refactoring involving import cleanup
```

```
[LEARN]
insight: Unused imports (`SkillSuggestion`, `UserRole`, `CacheOptions`) accumulate when code evolves - these are easy to miss without strict linter rules
context: Any TypeScript/Go project with large import lists
```

```
[ISSUE]
title: Unused imports keep accumulating
description: No automated check prevents committing code with unused imports. Consider adding a pre-commit hook or CI check that fails on unused imports.
type: improvement
severity: low
```
